0x003245.en: 「I'll show you what I can do!」

0x0032B3.en: 「No one handles Diablo better than me!」

0x0032F3.en: 「Got the first move!　I can do this!」

0x003324.en: 「If we fight, I give it my all!」

0x003406.en: 「Even against a Melior Esse,/ if I strike first!」

0x00344D.en: 「Highness!　I'm Zeoroot's daughter!/　My dad would've.../　done just what I'm doing!」

0x0034E6.en: 「Highness, why the rush!?/　Why are you so desperate!?」

0x00354E.en: 「Highness.....why go this far.....?/　Why the hurry, why!?」

0x0035B0.en: 「General Kirkus!/　As Zeoroot's daughter...../　I'll strike you down!」

0x003613.en: 「As a mecha pilot myself now,/　I can't overlook what you've done, Kirkus!」

0x003681.en: 「Why cling to power this much!?/　General Kirkus!」

0x0036E0.en: 「Of all people, I have to fight/　General Ort.....」

0x003730.en: 「General, that's cheating!/　Souping it up stronger/　than Diablo!」

0x00379C.en: 「Whoa... souped up like that,/　it's actually stronger than Diablo...!」

0x0037FE.en: 「!　That one looks pretty strong...../　I'd better be careful.」

0x003848.en: 「Ah.....I can tell./　That one's quite skilled.」

0x003886.en: 「That one's a real combat veteran...../　I'd better stay sharp.」

0x0038E8.en: 「Louzorl.....always,/　always getting in/　my big brother's way!」

0x00394E.en: 「Ugh!/　I don't have time/　to deal with you!」

0x0039A8.en: 「You're gross, Louzorl!/　I'm taking you down!」

0x0039F8.en: 「Ugh, a scary-looking guy...../　I don't like this.」

0x003A3C.en: 「Looks kinda tough...../　and that face is scary.」

0x003A7A.en: 「His moves are different from the rest...../　I've got to be careful.....」

0x003ACD.en: 「Ahmed, why are you/　doing this!?/　Please, just stop!」

0x003B42.en: 「If that's how it's gonna be...../　then I won't hold back either!」

0x003B9E.en: 「Pilots fighting each other...../　that's just wrong, Ahmed!」

0x003C12.en: 「Ratel, we've met before, right?/　But.....I won't hold back!」

0x003C7D.en: 「Having to fight Ratel...../　but I've got no choice!」

0x003CE8.en: 「Um.....I'm sorry, Ratel!/　I can't go easy on you!」

0x003D47.en: 「Huh?　I think I've met that one/　before... oh, never mind./　No time to think about that now!」

0x003DE6.en: 「Um, could you pull back?/　.....yeah, that's not gonna work./　I'm sorry!」

0x003E70.en: 「I feel bad, but...../　hesitating in battle is more dangerous.....」

0x003ECF.en: 「Perfectio!/　Go back to your own world!」

0x003F10.en: 「After all this,/　you still want to wage war!?」

0x003FF3.en: 「Whoever it is, I fight all out!」

0x004024.en: 「Looks like a Demon Golem,/　but even creepier.....」

0x004080.en: 「Monster or not, I'll pull this off!」

0x0040B7.en: 「To think such things exist on the surface.....」

0x0040EE.en: 「I'm not scared of the likes of you!」

0x0041CB.en: 「Ugh.....I have to fight that?/　It's so gross.....」

0x00421B.en: 「Blegh.....why...../　why is it so disgusting.....?/　I've got to beat it fast.....!」

0x004296.en: 「Big as it is, I won't lose!」

0x0042D3.en: 「So there are huge animals like that up top.....!」

0x004372.en: 「No way I'm getting absorbed by that!」

0x004436.en: 「Your past life/　has nothing to do with me!」

0x0044DC.en: 「If that's how it is, so can I!!」

0x00468B.en: 「No good, I can't take more!　Retreating!」

0x004721.en: 「Ah! No good, I can't take any more!」

0x00475B.en: 「Not yet!/ I won't give up yet!」

0x00478A.en: 「N-no good,/ I can't go down here yet!」

0x004858.en: 「What!?/ Pushed this hard by a mass-production unit...」

0x004932.en: 「No good, at this rate... I'll lose...!」

0x004AD5.en: 「Kyaaa!!/ Th-this is... Duraxil.../ No good... at this rate...」

0x004B50.en: 「Aah, no!/ At this rate I'll be absorbed!」

0x004BD4.en: 「Ngh.../ I won't let you/ change my fate...!」

0x004E54.en: 「A-as expected of General Kirkus.../ Head-on is a bad idea...」

0x004EAA.en: 「Ngh, this power's as I feared.../ Equal to Diablo, or more...!」

0x004F68.en: 「Yikes!/ I told you, I don't want/ to fight Louzorl!」

0x00512E.en: 「Th-this.../ Creepy, but I'm not down yet!」

0x005181.en: 「Ah.../ Ugh, I really hate this attack!」

0x005208.en: 「Ngh, I can't let the Ruina scare me...!」

0x005245.en: 「Aah, come on!/ I can't read its moves!」

0x0054BA.en: 「General Kirkus.../ Was that you holding back!?」

0x005504.en: 「I've done a few/ upgrades of my own too!」

0x005576.en: 「Ugh, gross, it hit me!/ So creepy...」

0x0055C6.en: 「Huh? Not so tough for that face.」

0x005600.en: 「Ahmed!/ Hold back and I'll be mad!」

0x005650.en: 「I knew it.../　These moves - that's the Shinki Mukyu style...」

0x0056D4.en: 「Th-there again.../ Why is this so creepy...」

0x00575B.en: 「Huh? Wait.../ Is Duraxil.../ maybe not that strong?」

0x005931.en: 「Ah... I saw it! I saw it too!」

0x0059D1.en: 「Upgrade all you want,/ as long as it doesn't hit!」

0x005A49.en: 「I knew it! Ratel,/ you came to Dad's dojo before, right?」

0x005AAB.en: 「Not scared, not scared of a "Lord of Ruin"!」

0x005CF4.en: 「A-as expected, Highness... dodging is all I can do...」

0x005D71.en: 「I don't want to take that attack...」

0x005F08.en: 「Ah... I've got no weapon to hit back!?」

0x005F3C.en: 「Ah... no good. Can't reach from here.」

0x006063.en: 「Big bro, leave the rest to me!」

0x0060F3.en: 「Lady Xenia, leave the rest to me!」

0x006124.en: 「I really don't want to... but I'll help!」

0x00615E.en: 「I don't like you.../ but right now we're allies...」

0x0063CF.en: 「Ngh... it's not like I want to protect you, but...」

0x00643A.en: 「If anything happens to Kouta,/　Shouko will...!」

0x006565.en: 「Fire enough and one's bound to hit!」

0x0066BF.en: 「Drop your guard and you'll regret it!/　Nutcracker!」

0x006732.en: 「Tah, yah, hah!/　I'm getting better too, you know!」

0x006829.en: 「This is a real applied technique/ of the Shinki Mukyu style too!」
